texts.preamble: Lee Kien Wen & Ors vs Unknown on 12 August, 2022 Author: Debangsu Basak Bench: Debangsu Basak 12.08.2022 Serial no.10 Aloke Crm (A) 3865 of 2022 In re : An Application for Anticipatory Bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Tangra Police Station Case No. 155 of 2022 dated 09.06.2022 under Sections 120B/420/269/272 of the Indian Penal Code. -And- In the matter of : Lee Kien Wen & Ors. ... ... Petitioners Mr. Sandipan Ganguly, Sr. Advocate Mr. Abdur Rakib, Advocate ... ...
texts.facts: Various samples were taken. One of the samples was found to be in accordance with the regulations. Some samples were found to be not unsafe food. There is an issue of applicability of the provisions of the Food and Safety Standard Act of 2006.
texts.arguments: Learned Senior Advocate appearing for the petitioners submits that the police cannot proceed against the petitioner in view of Table IV-A of the provisions of the Food and Safety and Standards ( Food Products and Additive) Regulations, 2011. Learned Advocate appearing for the State draws the attention to the forensic report and submits that the samples taken were found to be unsafe food.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned Senior Advocate appearing for the petitioners submits that the police cannot proceed against the petitioner in view of Table IV-A of the provisions of the Food and Safety and Standards ( Food Products and Additive) Regulations, 2011.
